question: In which of the following states of India is the legislative assembly election was held in late 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

The Himachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly election was held on November 12, 2022, with the results declared on December 8, 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian National Congress (INC) emerged victorious**, winning **40 out of the 68 seats**, ending the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) five-year rule in the state.
 
• The B**JP secured 25 seats**, falling short of a majority.
 
• Other parties, including the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), could not win any seats.
 
• This election continued the trend of the incumbent party losing in Himachal Pradesh since 1985.
 
• The **voter turnout was 75.5%**, slightly lower than the 2017 election.
